name: scr1be/coupon-ticket
description: A CMS widget that renders a cart price rule's coupon as a tear-off ticket: discount, validity and eligibility are read from the rule itself rather than retyped by the author, the customer-group check runs against the HTTP context so the page stays full-page cacheable, and the code copies to the clipboard from a dependency-free ES module. Registers its own porter with Scr1be_ContentTransfer so its widget instances travel with the rest of the content.
